results.name: Writer: a protected .docx keeps a SEALED draft (msoffcrypto + python-docx read it with the password; no plaintext on the server); Restore asks nothing more; Save stays encrypted and clears the draft

Spreadsheet adversary: password changed P1→P2 after the draft — Restore asks; a wrong password shows an inline alert; Cancel keeps the banner; P1 restores; Save keeps the CURRENT protection (P2 opens, P1 does not; openpyxl reads the cell)
